commands.name: ddd-init
commands.purpose: 在当前项目根落项目级骨架（根文档三件 + docs/ 结构 + 空图集 + 机器可读快照）

commands.name: ddd-intent
commands.purpose: 明确意图：把需求澄清到可设计、可验收

commands.name: ddd-arch
commands.purpose: 生成或更新 docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 与目录规划

commands.name: ddd-design
commands.purpose: 逐层生成或更新设计树

commands.name: ddd-review
commands.purpose: 冻结前独立交叉评审接口契约

commands.name: ddd-test-design
commands.purpose: 生成或更新测试用例树

commands.name: ddd-implement
commands.purpose: 按冻结契约落代码与单元测试

commands.name: ddd-test
commands.purpose: 执行四级测试并出报告与缺陷路由

commands.name: ddd-wrapup
commands.purpose: 收尾：清临时件、剔需求、发布版本；含跨树归并终检

commands.name: ddd-consolidate
commands.purpose: 冻结即归并：按模块/目录隔离重构为最终版（M12）

commands.name: ddd-board
commands.purpose: 看板闭环（M7）：查/增/转/证/弃/重挂 持久多步待办任务

commands.name: ddd-memo
commands.purpose: 记忆闭环（M6）：查记忆条目、候选提示
